pages.title: Two in the Saddle
pages.text:
Better Horses smooths out mounted travel.

- Two players can share one horse for co-op trips.
- The first rider keeps the reins.
- The second gets a back seat.

pages.title: Let the Horse Cruise
pages.text: Double-tap **W** while riding to enable auto-ride: the horse keeps moving forward and you just steer. Tap a movement key again to take back full control.

pages.title: Mud, Water, and Leaves
pages.text:
Horses handle bad terrain better now.

- They float instead of sinking in water.
- They move faster crossing water.
- Leaf blocks lose collision while you ride, so forests feel like a path.
